name: Mafia
subtitle: The town sleeps. The Mafia doesn't. Find them before it's too late.
description: Everyone gets a secret role: Villager, Mafia, Doctor or Detective. At night the Mafia choose a victim, the Doctor protects someone and the Detective investigates, all on their phones. By day the town argues and votes someone out. The TV can narrate so nobody sits out, or a player can narrate: their phone shows every role and night pick, and they reveal each death when they're ready. Town wins by finding every Mafia member; the Mafia win once they match the town in number.
